title: Codimension equals path length
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $P$ be a path on the $n$ coordinates, with length equal to the number of coordinates fixed by the path. In the vector space of binary vectors of length $n$, the codimension of the subspace of vectors that vanish on every coordinate fixed by $P$ equals the length of $P$.
